name: Dream Walk Scores
description: Walk, Bike and Transit scores for any US address, computed from OpenStreetMap, GTFS and open Census data. REST + GraphQL API, embeddable widget, and a drop-in Walk Score API compatibility endpoint.

PGSSLMODE.description: Force SSL for the managed Postgres connection.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public origin of this deployment, used in the links returned by the Walk Score compatibility endpoint. Leave blank to infer it from the request.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Enables the /admin operations dashboard. The dashboard is unavailable until this is set.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables AI-written 'why this score' summaries when a request passes ai=1. Scores themselves never depend on it; without a key the deterministic template is used.

AI_EXPLAIN_MODEL.description: Model used for explanations. A small, cheap model is the right choice here — it is rewriting a fact sheet, not reasoning.

REQUIRE_API_KEY.description: Set to 1 to require an API key on every request. Left unset the API is open, which is what the sibling Dream products expect.

STATIC_API_KEY.description: A single API key, for deployments that want one without managing the api_key table.

ANON_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Per-IP request ceiling for unauthenticated callers.

SCORE_CELL_METERS.description: Cache grid resolution in metres. Larger cells raise the hit rate and lower cost; smaller cells give finer spatial resolution.

OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.description: Comma-separated Overpass mirrors, tried in order. Point this at a self-hosted instance to remove the dependency on the public ones entirely.
